tools.name: vendty_get_client_info
tools.description: Show the Vendty API client behind this token: name, rate tier, the scopes the token has, and allowed origins. Use it to see which data tools work. Vendty API: GET /v1/me.

tools.name: vendty_list_products
tools.description: List products of the business: code, name, price, category and active flag. Use updated_since for incremental sync. Use include=stock with warehouse_id for stock levels. Vendty API: GET /v1/products. Scope products:read. Offset pagination.

tools.name: vendty_get_product
tools.description: Get one product by its public ID, with its details. Vendty API: GET /v1/products/{id}. Scope products:read.

tools.name: vendty_list_categories
tools.description: List the product categories of the business. Vendty API: GET /v1/categories. Scope products:read. Offset pagination.

tools.name: vendty_list_customers
tools.description: List the business's customers (third parties) with tax ID, contact data and group. Use identification for an exact tax ID match. Vendty API: GET /v1/customers. Scope customers:read. Offset pagination.

tools.name: vendty_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by its public ID. Vendty API: GET /v1/customers/{id}. Scope customers:read.

tools.name: vendty_list_customer_groups
tools.description: List the customer groups (price or discount groups) of the business. Vendty API: GET /v1/customer-groups. Scope customers:read. Offset pagination.

tools.name: vendty_list_customer_sales
tools.description: List the sales of one customer, newest first. Pass meta.next_cursor as cursor for the next page. Vendty API: GET /v1/customers/{id}/sales. Scopes customers:read and sales:read.

tools.name: vendty_list_sales
tools.description: List sales of the business with customer, seller, warehouse and totals. Cursor pagination: pass meta.next_cursor as cursor. date_from to date_to can span at most 90 days. Vendty API: GET /v1/sales. Scope sales:read.

tools.name: vendty_get_sale
tools.description: Get one sale by its public ID, with its lines and payments. Vendty API: GET /v1/sales/{id}. Scope sales:read.

tools.name: vendty_list_payment_methods
tools.description: List the payment methods the business accepts (cash, card, and others). Vendty API: GET /v1/payment-methods. Scope sales:read. Offset pagination.

tools.name: vendty_list_sale_credit_notes
tools.description: List the credit notes (notas crédito) issued against one sale. Vendty API: GET /v1/sales/{id}/credit-notes. Scope credit-notes:read.

tools.name: vendty_list_restaurant_sections
tools.description: List the floors and sections of the restaurant. Vendty API: GET /v1/restaurant/sections. Scope restaurant:read. Restaurant businesses only.

tools.name: vendty_list_restaurant_tables
tools.description: List the restaurant tables with their live state (occupied or free). Vendty API: GET /v1/restaurant/tables. Scope restaurant:read. Restaurant businesses only.

tools.name: vendty_get_restaurant_table_order
tools.description: Get the open order of one restaurant table, with its items, additions and kitchen state. Vendty API: GET /v1/restaurant/tables/{id}/order. Scope restaurant:read.

tools.name: vendty_list_quick_service_orders
tools.description: List the open Quick Service orders (zone -1), grouped by virtual table. Vendty API: GET /v1/quick-service/orders. Scope restaurant:read.

tools.name: vendty_list_warehouses
tools.description: List the warehouses (almacenes, bodegas) of the business. Vendty API: GET /v1/warehouses. Scope catalogs:read. Offset pagination.

tools.name: vendty_list_taxes
tools.description: List the taxes (impuestos) configured for the business. Vendty API: GET /v1/taxes. Scope catalogs:read.

tools.name: vendty_list_sellers
tools.description: List the sellers (vendedores, commission agents) of the business. Vendty API: GET /v1/sellers. Scope catalogs:read.

tools.name: vendty_list_users
tools.description: List the human users of the business (not API clients). Vendty API: GET /v1/users. Scope catalogs:read.

tools.name: vendty_list_price_lists
tools.description: List the price lists (listas de precio) of the business. Vendty API: GET /v1/price-lists. Scope catalogs:read.

tools.name: vendty_list_suppliers
tools.description: List the suppliers (proveedores) of the business. Vendty API: GET /v1/suppliers. Scope purchases:read. Offset pagination.

tools.name: vendty_list_purchase_orders
tools.description: List purchase invoices (facturas de compra) with supplier and totals. Cursor pagination: pass meta.next_cursor as cursor. Vendty API: GET /v1/purchase-orders. Scope purchases:read.

tools.name: vendty_get_purchase_order
tools.description: Get one purchase invoice by its public ID, with its lines and payments. Vendty API: GET /v1/purchase-orders/{id}. Scope purchases:read.

tools.name: vendty_list_support_documents
tools.description: List DIAN support documents (documentos soporte) for purchases from suppliers. Cursor pagination: pass meta.next_cursor as cursor. Vendty API: GET /v1/support-documents. Scope purchases:read.

tools.name: vendty_get_support_document
tools.description: Get one support document by its public ID. Vendty API: GET /v1/support-documents/{id}. Scope purchases:read.

tools.name: vendty_list_reports
tools.description: List the asynchronous report jobs generated for the business, with their status. Cursor pagination: pass meta.next_cursor as cursor. Vendty API: GET /v1/reports. Scope reports:read.

tools.name: vendty_get_report
tools.description: Get one report job by its public ID: status and, when ready, where to download the file. Vendty API: GET /v1/reports/{id}. Scope reports:read.
